assign.outcome:
**Both calls are in core: an open column never pays for the next one, and even columns got a `fit` toggle.**

**Call 1 — the freeze.** One declaration in `core/Page/Page.css`: `flex: var(--page-column-flex, 1 1 0)` became `0 0 var(--page-column-recommended, clamp(40em, 42cqi, 46em))`. A column's width used to be a function of how many columns were open; it is now a function of itself, so a column that is already open never narrows when the next one opens and no nav link below its prose moves. `large` came with it and had to — it never set a flex of its own, it *grew* into its 64em ceiling, so frozen it would have been a flat 1024px at every width; it now reads `0 0 clamp(28em, 50cqi, 64em)`. `small`, `hug`, `fill`, `full`, a drag, the even mode and the `< 32em` phone regime are all untouched and all still win.

**Call 2 — the toggle.** `this.columns({ even: true, fit: "round" })`. `floor` stays the default (a column is never narrower than the width it recommends); `round` fills the room tighter and lets a column go under it. Stored as `column_fit`, prefixed, for the same reason `column_even` is.

**The crawl.** 12 columns hosts × 1280 / 1920 / 3440 = 36 runs, before and after, headless, one fresh context each. **0 console errors on all five core hosts both times.** What changed:

| host | 1280 | 1920 | 3440 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `/imagine/` — the `large` Start column | 962 → **640** | 1024 → **960** | 1152 → 1152 |
| `/imagine/platform/` — two topic columns | 535 → **640** each | 806 → **960** each | 1152 → 1152 |
| `/imagine/platform/research/` | 421 / 648 → **640 / 430** | 448 / 1165 → **960 / 653** | 504 / 2504 → **1152 / 1856** |
| `uses/docs`, `inbox`, `split`, `workbench` | unchanged | unchanged | unchanged |

The four `uses/` screens never moved because a rail plus one reading column is 812px in a 1039px box — there was no squeeze there to remove. 535px *was* a reading column 66px under its own measure, and it is now at it.

**Where the sideways scroll appears** — exactly where the squeeze used to be and nowhere else: `/imagine/platform/` overflows **211px at 1280** and **307px at 1920**, and **0 at 3440** where three columns still fit. Every other page in the crawl arrives with row overflow 0.

**The two numbers that had to agree, agree.** 36 runs before, 36 after. And the lab's *today* row — built from core's own classes — read 129px of nav movement and 225px of width change at 1280 before this; it reads **0 and 0** now at 400, 1280, 1920 and 3440, the same two zeros my crawl reads.

![the lab, all three rows at 0](/framework/ai/2026-09-17/calls-core/lab-all-zero-1920.png)

**The alternative is written down, not thrown away.** `34cqi` holds still *and* fills 3440, but makes a reading column 357px at 1280. It sits beside the change in [columns.md](/framework/core/Page/doc/columns/) with the sentence that picks between them: *hosts that must fill a wide screen use even columns.*

**Left, with reasons:** the lab's *Today* row still wears a warning icon and prints `lab.js`'s "narrow enough that the site pages it one column at a time" sentence, which is now false — that string is in `navigation/lab.js`, outside the fence I was given (the caption in `page.js` only). Its preview card `shots/stability-card.png` still shows the old 129/225 readout for the same reason. Both are one small edit for whoever owns that lab next.
